::: {#rem-infix-parentheses}
#### Inorder needs parentheses

The inorder (@def-inorder) of the tree of @fig-expression is

$$
7 - 2 \times 3 + 4 \times 2,
$$

the symbols of the expression in their order, without the parentheses.
With the usual precedence (@rem-expression-parse-tree), this string groups as $(7 - (2 \times 3)) + (4 \times 2)$,
whose parse tree has $+$ at its root and whose value is 9, not 55.
So the inorder needs parentheses to give back the expression,
for example a pair around each operation: $((7 - 2) \times (3 + (4 \times 2)))$.
The prefix form (@def-prefix-form) and the postfix form (@def-postfix-form) need no parentheses,
since each operation has exactly two operands.

:::
